summary.zh: 查询当前非限制使用库存，按完整物料移动历史重建 FIFO 数量账龄，并检查慢动、呆滞和临期风险。
summary.en: Reads current unrestricted-use stock, reconstructs FIFO quantity-age layers from complete material-movement history, and checks slow-moving, obsolete, and expiry risks.

zh: 最后库存活动日期（兼容字段）
距最后库存活动天数（兼容字段）
库存账龄下限（兼容字段）
最早剩余库存层账龄（天）
未达到最低已启用阈值数量
en: Days since last inventory activity (compatibility field)
Quantity below the lowest enabled threshold

zh: 只统计库存类型 01 且非特殊库存的当前库存
慢动或呆滞检查必须读取完整移动历史并与当前库存对平
用户留空的检查不执行，也不计为证据缺失
不同单位的库存不得合计
证据不完整时不得输出确定账龄数量
全部 SAP 访问为 GET-only
en: Count only current stock type 01 with no special-stock indicator
Slow-moving or obsolete checks require complete movement history reconciled to current stock
A blank optional check is not executed and is not treated as missing evidence
Never aggregate stock across different units
Do not output definitive age quantities from incomplete evidence

description.zh: 自动使用运行当天作为快照日，根据已填写的天数启用检查；阈值只用于分类，不限制移动历史。
description.en: Uses the run date as the snapshot and enables supplied checks; thresholds classify layers and never bound movement history.

purpose.zh: 生成检查开关和完整历史截止日
purpose.en: Generate check switches and the complete-history cutoff

description.zh: 始终查询指定物料、工厂和库存地点的当前非限制使用、非特殊库存。
description.en: Always reads current unrestricted-use, non-special stock for the exact material, plant, and storage location.

title.zh: 按需读取完整移动历史
title.en: Read complete movement history when requested

description.zh: 慢动或呆滞检查读取截止快照日的完整物料凭证数量、借贷方向、库存维度及 Header 时间。
description.en: Slow-moving or obsolete checks read complete material-document quantities, debit/credit direction, stock dimensions, and header timestamps through the snapshot date.

purpose.zh: 读取完整 FIFO 重建证据

description.zh: 移动历史读取后再次读取相同库存范围；两次快照不一致时不输出确定账龄。
description.en: Rereads the same stock scope after movement history; differing snapshots suppress definitive aging.

description.zh: 仅当填写临期天数时读取批次效期，并只关联当前正库存批次。
description.en: Reads batch expiry only when requested and relates it only to batches with positive current stock.

description.zh: 只评估本次实际启用的证据主题，未启用检查不记缺口。
description.en: Assesses only requested evidence topics; disabled checks do not create gaps.

purpose.zh: 判定是否存在实时 Schema 能力缺口
purpose.en: Determine whether live schema proves a capability gap

description.zh: 逐个核对正库存批次的 API 效期证据，并仅在缺失、无法关联、冲突或查询不完整时请求只读 MCHA 补充。
description.en: Checks API expiry evidence for every positive-stock batch and requests read-only MCHA only for missing, unmatched, conflicting, or incomplete evidence.

purpose.zh: 决定是否需要只读 MCHA 补充
purpose.en: Decide whether read-only MCHA evidence is required

description.zh: 仅在实时 Schema 直接证明库存 API 能力缺口时调用只读 MARD。
description.en: Uses read-only MARD only when live schema directly proves a stock-API capability gap.

description.zh: 仅在已启用移动检查且实时 Schema 直接证明 API 能力缺口时调用只读 MATDOC。
description.en: Uses read-only MATDOC only for an enabled movement check with a live-schema-proven API capability gap.

description.zh: 仅在已启用临期检查且正库存批次的 API 效期证据不足时调用只读 MCHA。
description.en: Uses read-only MCHA only when an enabled expiry check has unresolved API evidence for positive-stock batches.

description.zh: 以 Decimal 和 FIFO 重建剩余库存层，按互斥账龄桶形成风险结论，不生成调拨建议。
description.en: Reconstructs remaining inventory layers with Decimal FIFO and exclusive age buckets without producing transfer advice.

description.zh: 留空则不执行慢动检查。
description.en: Leave blank to skip the slow-moving check.

description.zh: 留空则不执行呆滞检查。
description.en: Leave blank to skip the obsolete-stock check.

description.zh: 留空则不执行临期检查。
description.en: Leave blank to skip the expiry check.

title.zh: 最后库存活动日期（兼容字段）
距最后库存活动天数（兼容字段）
title.en: Days since last inventory activity (compatibility field)

title.zh: 库存账龄下限（兼容字段）
最早剩余库存层账龄（天）
未达到最低已启用阈值数量
title.en: Quantity below the lowest enabled threshold

plan.rationale: Read the exact current unrestricted-use, non-special stock snapshot.
Read the complete unrestricted-use movement history through the snapshot date for FIFO quantity-layer reconstruction.
Reread the exact current stock after movement history to detect concurrent stock changes.
Read material-level and plant-level batch expiry evidence; positive-stock association is validated deterministically.

acceptance.recordScope: one current inventory-health summary for the exact material, plant, and storage location

metricDefinitions.current_unrestricted_stock: Current stock type 01 with blank special-stock type; never summed across different units.
metricDefinitions.days_since_last_movement_activity: Compatibility activity indicator only; it is never used to classify the age of all current stock.
metricDefinitions.oldest_remaining_layer_age_days: Calendar-day age of the oldest positive FIFO inventory layer remaining after complete movement reconstruction.
metricDefinitions.classified_stock_quantity: Current stock quantity reconciled exactly to complete FIFO movement layers.
metricDefinitions.unclassified_stock_quantity: Current stock quantity whose age cannot be classified because a required FIFO completeness or reconciliation gate failed.
metricDefinitions.below_threshold_stock_quantity: FIFO remaining quantity below the lowest enabled movement-age threshold.
metricDefinitions.slow_moving_only_stock_quantity: FIFO remaining quantity that reached the slow-moving threshold but not the obsolete threshold.
metricDefinitions.obsolete_stock_quantity: FIFO remaining quantity at or above the enabled obsolete threshold.
metricDefinitions.expiry_candidate_count: Compatibility alias for positive-stock batches expiring from snapshot date through the requested future-day threshold.
metricDefinitions.expired_batch_count: Positive-stock batches whose shelf-life expiration date is earlier than the snapshot date.
metricDefinitions.expiring_batch_count: Positive-stock batches expiring from the snapshot date through the requested future-day threshold.
metricDefinitions.missing_expiry_date_batch_count: Positive-stock batches without an authoritative usable expiration date after approved fallback.

acceptance.businessStatusDefinition: snapshot_only when no checks are requested; normal or attention only when enabled evidence is complete and FIFO movement layers reconcile exactly to two identical stock snapshots; no_stock for a complete empty current-stock result; otherwise inconclusive.

summary.zh: 独立直连基线、自由查询和固定 Agent 的业务语义一致。
summary.en: The independent direct-SAP baseline, free query, and fixed Agent are semantically consistent.
